text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Intermittent fasting combined with calorie restriction produced greater weight loss in obese women than the comparison diet.","cited_pids":["23334c40ad6b#1"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"A high-protein intermittent-fasting diet produced weight loss in obese adults.","cited_pids":["c74e11d8769a#0"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A meta-analysis found intermittent energy restriction comparable to continuous restriction on weight loss and cardiometabolic outcomes.","cited_pids":["e5aee0e45fc5#0"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"A Cochrane review of 22 trials with nearly 2,000 adults found intermittent fasting did not produce significantly more weight loss than standard diet advice.","cited_pids":["5a896703f2e3#0"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"A Harvard review notes that research does not consistently show intermittent fasting is superior to continuous low calorie diets.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#2"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"A one-year trial of 100 obese individuals found intermittent fasting no more effective than daily calorie restriction.","cited_pids":["44e3472ec92d#7"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"One meta-analysis reported a modest advantage for fasting in body weight change.","cited_pids":["f5eeafdf6fc3#1"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Overall, intermittent fasting works about as well as continuous calorie reduction but not clearly better.","cited_pids":[]}]}
